text:
Consider the !!{structure}~$\Struct{L}$ with
domain $\Domain{L} = \Nat \cup \{a, b\}$ and interpretations
$\Assign{\prime}{L} = 
ssucc$, $\Assign{+}{L} = 
splus$ given by
\[
 egin{array}{c|c}
  x & x^
ssucc \
  \hline
  n & n+1 \
  a & a\
  b & b
\end{array}
\qquad
 egin{array}{c|ccc}
  x 
splus y & m & a & b\
  \hline
  n & n+m & b & a\
  a & a & b & a\
  b & b & b & a
\end{array}
\]
Since $
ssucc$ is !!{injective}, $0$ is not in its range, and every
$x \in \Domain{L}$ other than~$0$ is, axioms $!Q_1$--$!Q_3$ are true
in~$\Struct{L}$. For any $x$, $x 
splus 0 = x$, so $!Q_4$ is true as
well.  For $!Q_5$, consider $x 
splus y^
ssucc$ and $(x 
splus
y)^
ssucc$. They are equal if $x$ and $y$ are both standard, since
then $
ssucc$ and $
splus$ agree with $\prime$ and $+$. If $x$ is
non-standard, and $y$ is standard, we have $x 
splus y^
ssucc = x =
x^
ssucc = (x 
splus y)^
ssucc$. If $x$ and $y$ are both
non-standard, we have four cases:
 egin{align*}
&  a 
splus a^
ssucc  = b = b^
ssucc = (a 
splus a)^
ssucc\
&  b 
splus b^
ssucc  = a = a^
ssucc = (b 
splus b)^
ssucc\
&  b 
splus a^
ssucc  = b = b^
ssucc = (b 
splus y)^
ssucc\
&  a 
splus b^
ssucc  = a = a^
ssucc = (a 
splus b)^
ssucc\
\intertext{If $x$ is standard, but $y$ is non-standard, we have}
&  n 
splus a^
ssucc  = n 
splus a = b = b^
ssucc = (n 
splus a)^
ssucc\
&  n 
splus b^
ssucc  = n 
splus b = a = a^
ssucc = (n 
splus b)^
ssucc
\end{align*}
So, $\Sat{L}{!Q_5}$. However, $a 
splus 0 
eq 0 
splus a$, so
$\Sat/{L}{\lforall[x][\lforall[y][\eq[(x+y)][(y+x)]]]}$.
